title: Quick-Fix Brazilian Sour Cream Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful Brazilian-inspired pilaf made with sour cream, rice, and spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the jasmine rice and stir to coat with the butter mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed.
While the rice cooks, mix the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Once the rice is cooked, stir in the sour cream and spice mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the mixture is well combined, and the sour cream has melted.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
